note: WAEC Islamic Studies round 5 (Round 25 top-up): asbab al-nuzul, Makki surah themes, Zayd ibn Thabit's compilation; isnad, matn, Sahih al-Bukhari, da'if grade, al-Muwatta of Imam Malik; ijma, qiyas, Abu Hanifah's school, Maliki north; tayammum when water fails, ghusl after marital relations, 4 wudu obligations; jumu'ah replacing zuhr, qiblah condition, iqamah, janazah without ruku or sujud; traveller's deferral, i'tikaf, suhur; zakat al-fitr, the poor and needy among the asnaf, gold nisab 85 grams; Arafat on 9 Dhul-Hijjah, 7 pebbles per jamrah, no sewn garments in ihram, tawaf al-ifadah on the day of sacrifice; Aminah bint Wahb, Halimah, Khadijah, Abu Talib, Fatimah; Quba mosque, the Ansar, mu'akhah brotherhood. Scanned against WAEC rounds 1-4, NECO IRS (all rounds) and the JAMB pool.
